method: Maven Central binary jar pinned by SHA-256 with Central-published SHA-1/MD5 provenance; fetched once at build time by fetch-jar.py with URL-identity plus size plus hash verification. No repository resolution during builds. Source-building is infeasible: the frozen jcardsim pom installs oracle.javacard api_classic from ${env.JC_CLASSIC_HOME} (proprietary Oracle JavaCard SDK, not a freezable public input).

artifacts.license_observation: Apache-2.0 jcardsim sources with shaded BouncyCastle 1.71 plus kryo 5.2.0 plus bundled Oracle api_classic 3.0.5 javacard classes; see FILE-NOTICES.txt
